info.description: Mellifera HTTP edge: scan-root (library) management, item browse/detail, and admin liveness. Every handler is pure delegation (parse -> one domain call -> write).
info.title: Mellifera API

get.summary: List items (optionally filtered by library + status)
Get a single item with its full document

put.summary: Replace an item's element-only parser attachments

parameters.description: ordered parser ids (full replacement; empty clears)
parameters.name: request

delete.summary: Clear an item's element-only parser attachments

post.summary: Play one item (the only playback mutation)

get.summary: Get a single library with its module presentation block

patch.summary: Update a library's display name, description, and/or parser chain

get.summary: Depth-1 folder prefixes and item counts for a library

post.summary: Trigger a scan for a library

get.summary: Item count and last-update stamp for a library
Get one item's stored playback position

put.summary: Store the playback position for an item

get.summary: Get a single series with its full serial-level document
